create_EventList: create an EventList to store and manage profiling events from torch.autograd.profiler
build_table_EventList: build a formatted table from an EventList showing CPU, CUDA, and memory profiling statistics
export_chrome_trace_EventList: export an EventList as a Chrome tracing file for inspection via chrome://tracing
key_averages_EventList: key averages FunctionEvent objects in an EventList grouped by name, input shapes, or stack depth
create_FunctionEvent: create a FunctionEvent object to hold profiling information for a single function call
